name: bookbridge
description: Transfer locally downloaded EPUB files to a phone on the same LAN.

scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @bookbridge/protocol lint && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/web lint && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/extension lint && node --check scripts/smoke-extension-ui.mjs && node --check scripts/manual-acceptance-server.mjs && prettier --check .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bookbridge/protocol test && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/web test && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/extension test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bookbridge/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @bookbridge/extension typecheck
